text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks after gains, which felt satisfying, but I should not let the pleasure of locking in profits replace a plan based on each stock’s outlook and my portfolio needs.","Selling winners in several rounds reduced my exposure while prices were rising; I should consider whether trimming is leaving my holdings too concentrated in cash or missing further gains.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should set clear risk and selling rules in advance rather than letting the discomfort of a loss—or the satisfaction of a gain—drive decisions."]}
